mpLib_80056C54 uses sqrtf_store solely for a volatile binary32 store/reload; the two scratch results are not otherwise read. Negative indices reconstruct retail stack slots outside the declared array and corrupt native caller state. Use distinct in-bounds scratch elements, preserving every arithmetic operation, branch, store width and output. Both traversal directions receive the same class repair.
